en.item.eclipse.heart_fragment.lore: A life, quartered and still warm.

en.item.eclipse.glitch_shard.lore: A splinter of something that never was.
en.item.eclipse.umbral_shard.lore: Night, chipped loose and made currency.
en.item.eclipse.compass_of_watcher.lore: It points. It never says who.
en.item.eclipse.vitae_shard.lore: A heartbeat, waiting for a chest.
en.item.eclipse.umbral_pick.lore: It bites deepest under open night.
en.item.eclipse.revive_sigil.lore: One name, carved back into the world.
en.item.eclipse.ferryman_toll.lore: Fare for a crossing no one returns.
en.item.eclipse.fog_core.lore: The storm, knotted small and quiet.
en.item.eclipse.fog_cloak_trim.lore: A cut from the mantle of fog.
